description: This file defines the GroupDao interface for accessing and managing Group entities in the data layer, providing methods to retrieve groups by permissions, group type, and IDs.

classes.name: GroupDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Group entities, extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects associated with the specified permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by the specified GroupType.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects matching the provided set of IDs.
